scope: A proposed bounded private VM backing lifecycle. This is not PCIe/chip/firmware/DART/DMA or Wi-Fi readiness. A coherent guest report remains a guest self-report.

design_names.status: Design identities only; no such built member is admitted by this contract.

criteria.required: Freeze and independently review the observer, record codec/classifier, read-only collector, isolated host integration and actual SDK/KC/RAM packet. Bind all source receipts and actual executable member bytes. Review actual KPI dependencies, including Unsupported where required. No unknown hashes or name-only member checks may substitute for the final packet review.

Use a fresh policy nonce independent of the existing console-proof nonce. Preserve exact original ADT/736-byte BootArgs, complete384 MCC sample with all96 attempted/completed reads, base ADT, final1152 native wire, facts wire and exact final ADT upload/readback. Recompute actual hashes and independently reproduce source inventory, facts and insertion. Missing old data must not be reconstructed.

Keep the original ADT capacity, placements, m1n1 and canonical controller unchanged until a separately admitted isolated revision is applied. Before start, verify final measured size fits the original reservation; actual HV.start upload/readback and seven-word start guard must agree. A predicted plan or preupload alone is not proof of the actual final upload.

Require exactly one admitted observer attempt under the explicit bootarg, no automatic rematch/retry, and one configuration attempt. Compare the216 expected identity bytes with independently retained host inputs. Hash equality labels those inputs; it is not authentication or a global source census.

On configuration success only, acquire one buffer through the same public owner facade; zero once; request one16-byte nonce copy at offset0; inspect; attempt public guarded retirement once only after successful acquisition; inspect again. All prior errors remain sticky failures. No raw refs, manual freeing, owner replacement, guard shrinking, effects or retry.

The coherent success record must match exact frozen API return codes and source-defined state/counter predicates. After retirement, historical owned_pairs remains3; balanced_pairs3, resets_returned3 and identity_records0 show no outstanding pairs in that report. Never replace this with the incorrect owned_pairs0 criterion. Reject busy, halted, pending, first-error, exposed/effect or unretired states.

Export one bounded exact-format property through read-only registry calls; verify raw length, framing, digest, record nonce and all fixed component labels, reserved zeros, order and attempt masks with an independent decoder. Missing, PENDING, malformed or foreign records fail. Gated/no-attempt77 has zero identity and record_nonce_bound=false; it cannot qualify.

Keep data_readback=false, synthetic_metadata=true and effect_commands=0 explicit. A successful copy return code is not data readback. Synthetic RID/SID/vector/IOVA fields are not observed BCM4378 identity or mapping permission. No shared APCIE PHY/PMGR, feature, GPU, firmware, BAR, DART or device3 work is added.

Preserve exact console TX with only the bootstrap, strict challenge and fixed collector launcher; seal afterward. No host HID, scheduler, typing request or interactive prerequisite. Record actual worker status, capture completion and bounded diagnostic results separately from the command result.

After one separately authorized cycle, independently verify a new Linux boot using the saved baseline and controller recovery certificate. A missing/new-boot mismatch keeps the recovery latch. Record reset count, native reset return status and Linux evidence without rewriting an earlier receipt.

failure_handling: Preserve the raw attempt and every failed or unevaluated criterion. Unknown configuration/allocation outcome remains failure with controls retained; no cleanup guess or automatic retry. Do not regrade old captures using this contract.
not_claimed: Global exclusion completeness or source authentication
Physical chip identity, link or PCIe port readiness
External DMA, IOMMU, IRQ or firmware safety
hardware: STOP003 remains; M1 last verified Linux. No actor, SSH, boot, reset or Signal in this work.
